Class Sets

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.gaia.core.collect.Sets
public final class Sets extends Object
Static factories and a collector for unmodifiable sets that iterate in the order their elements are given.

The set methods behave exactly like their Set.of counterparts, and setCopy(Collection) like Set.copyOf, and toSet() like Collectors.toUnmodifiableSet(), except for iteration order. Set.of and Set.copyOf leave the order unspecified, and it changes from one run to the next. These sets iterate, stream and convert to arrays in the order the elements were given. Otherwise they are the same:

  • They are unmodifiable: every mutator method throws UnsupportedOperationException, even when the call would not change the set.
  • They reject null elements, and querying them with null, as in contains(null), throws NullPointerException.
  • The set methods reject duplicate elements with IllegalArgumentException. setCopy(Collection) and toSet() accept duplicates and keep the first occurrence of each.
  • They are serializable if all their elements are.
  • They are value-based: do not rely on their identity.
  • equals and hashCode follow the Set contract, so a set from this class equals a Set.of set with the same elements, whatever their order.

    • setCopy

      public static <E> Set<E> setCopy(Collection<? extends E> collection)
      Returns an unmodifiable set containing the elements of collection, iterating in the collection's iteration order. Duplicates are allowed: the first occurrence of each element is kept. If collection is already a set returned by this class, it is returned as is.
      Type Parameters:
      E - the element type
      Parameters:
      collection - the collection whose elements to copy
      Returns:
      a set containing the elements of collection
      See Also:
      • Set.copyOf(Collection)

    • toSet

      public static <E> Collector<E,?,Set<E>> toSet()
      Returns a collector into an unmodifiable set that iterates in encounter order: the ordered counterpart of Collectors.toUnmodifiableSet(). Duplicates are allowed: the first occurrence of each element is kept. The resulting set behaves like the other sets of this class.
      Type Parameters:
      E - the element type
      Returns:
      a collector into an ordered, unmodifiable set
